q: What should I do if I don't have enough pantry items for a recipe?
a: If you’re missing ingredients, Eatlystic will suggest recipes that fit what you do have, or help you create a shopping list for any items you need.

q: What if I forget about an item that's expiring soon?
a: No worries! Eatlystic will send reminder notifications to your browser and email before a pantry item expires, so you never miss saving your food.

q: Can I like or bookmark my favorite recipes?
a: Yes, simply use the heart or 'Like' button on any recipe page to save it to your Favorites, making it easy to revisit later.

q: How can I keep track of my fitness level?
a: Every pantry item and recipe you consume is tracked by Eatlystic. It shows the nutrients and calories you've consumed and suggests recipes to help you achieve your fitness targets.
keywords: fitness level track calories nutrients goals

q: How do I stay up to date with trending recipes and see what others are having?
a: Visit the Trending page where Eatlystic displays the most popular recipes among users, helping you discover new meal ideas and stay inspired.

q: How do I set and manage my goals in Eatlystic?
